title: Correct gravitational acceleration
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be g = 6 m/s² (to one significant figure).

title: Correct average density
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be ρ = 4 × 10³ kg/m³ (to one significant figure).

title: Energy or work-energy analysis
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem or energy conservation, accounting for work done by F, gravity, and friction over the two displacement segments.

title: Planet mass from gravity
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate surface g to planetary mass M using g = GM/R².

title: Density formula application
description: Important: The solution must compute density using ρ = M/V with V = (4/3)πR³.

title: Forces on inclined plane
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve gravitational force and compute the normal force (mg cosθ) and kinetic friction force (μ mg cosθ).

title: Graph data extraction
description: Optional: The solution should correctly read F₁=15 N for 0–6 m and F₂=3 N for 6–12 m from the force-displacement graph.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Penalize if work done by gravity or friction is given the wrong sign (e.g., treating them as positive when they oppose motion up the incline).

title: Unit or significant figure error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if final answers lack correct units (m/s², kg/m³) or are not given to one significant figure as instructed.
